definition_zh: 含位移等变量偶次幂非线性项的力学关系。
usage_overview: 在非线性随机振子分析中，以位移或速度的平方等偶次幂项体现，用于考察响应概率分布的变化；在这类模型中，可引起均值偏移和分布不对称。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P045.title: Transient probabilistic solutions of stochastic oscillator with even nonlinearities by exponential polynomial closure method
P045.authors: K Wang, Z Zhu, L Xu
P045.label: Wang等（2022）

complete_examples.text: Numerical results also show that the transient probability density function solutions of the system responses are not symmetric about their nonzero means due to the existence of even nonlinearities.

Numerical analysis show that the extended exponential polynomial closure method with polynomial order being six is both effective and efficient for solving the transient analysis of the stochastic oscillator with even nonlinearities by comparing the numerical results obtained by the proposed method with those obtained by Monte Carlo simulation method.
